• The word **"Adress"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling should be "Address." (पता)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** An address refers to the details of a location where someone lives or works, usually including street name, city, and postal code.

• **Example:** Please provide your complete address for the delivery of the parcel.
 
 
 
• **"Address"** is the correct word, properly spelt. (पता)

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Police** (पुलिस): A civil force responsible for maintaining law and order and preventing crime.

 
 
• **Example:** The police arrived at the scene within minutes of the emergency call.
 
 
 
• **Policy** (नीति): A set of guidelines or rules adopted by an organization or individual.
 
 
• **Example:** The company's refund policy is very customer-friendly.
 
 
 
• **Issue** (मुद्दा): A topic or subject for discussion, debate, or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** The issue of climate change needs immediate global attention.
